root.label: std::simd (C++26)
root.note: P1928 and follow-ups: portable data-parallel vector and mask types in namespace std::simd.

children.label: Types and widths
children.note: basic_vec<T, Abi> and basic_mask<Bytes, Abi>, used through the vec and mask aliases.

children.label: vec<T> and vec<T, N>
children.note: Native width for the target, or exactly N lanes; N from 1 to 64 is always supported.

children.label: Vectorizable types
children.note: Standard integers, characters, float, double, fixed-width floats, and complex of those; not bool or long double.

children.label: Names from P3691
children.note: Formerly std::datapar, basic_simd and simd_mask; older pages use the old names.

children.label: Construction
children.note: Every way of making a vector checks conversions strictly.

children.label: Broadcast
children.note: A scalar fills every lane only if its conversion is value-preserving, so vec<float> * 2 fails.

children.label: Generator
children.note: Explicit; calls the callable once per lane with integral_constant<i>, in increasing order.

children.label: Vector conversions
children.note: Explicit when values could be lost or rank would drop; float to double is implicit.

children.label: Read-only lanes
children.note: operator[] returns value_type by value; vectors are read-only ranges (P3480).

children.label: Masks
children.note: Comparisons are element-wise and return a mask, never a bool.

children.label: No operator bool
children.note: if (a < b) is ill-formed; say what you mean with a reduction.

children.label: Mask reductions
children.note: all_of, any_of, none_of, reduce_count, reduce_min_index, reduce_max_index.

children.label: select
children.note: select(m, a, b) blends lanes; both sides are computed. Replaces the TS where-expressions.

children.label: Memory
children.note: Explicit loads and stores between vectors and contiguous ranges.

children.label: unchecked_load and store
children.note: Need at least V::size() elements; too few is ill-formed if constant, otherwise UB.

children.label: partial_load and store
children.note: Any size; missing lanes load as T() and are never read or written.

children.label: Flags
children.note: flag_convert allows lossy loads; flag_aligned and flag_overaligned<N> promise alignment.

children.label: Gather and scatter
children.note: unchecked_ and partial_gather_from and scatter_to use an index vector (P2664).

children.label: Algorithms
children.note: Whole-vector operations beyond arithmetic.

children.label: reduce
children.note: Generalized sum with a commutative op; masked form returns the identity if no lane is selected.

children.label: Math and bits
children.note: Element-wise <cmath>, <bit> and complex functions, plus min, max and clamp.

children.label: Permutations
children.note: permute, compress, expand, chunk and cat move lanes around.

children.label: Implementation status
children.note: Where <simd> works in late 2026.

children.label: GCC 16
children.note: Experimental, x86 with SSE2 only; __cpp_lib_simd is never defined. Nothing on AArch64.

children.label: Clang 21
children.note: libc++ has no <simd> yet.
